manifest.fit_policy: fit preprocessors on train only; validation and test are transform-only
manifest.identifier_feature_policy: identifiers are excluded from model inputs; overlaps are reported for audit only

selection_policy: model selection uses validation constraint feasibility, recall, PR-AUC, precision, and lower FPR; threshold selection maximizes recall and then chooses the lowest feasible boundary for temporal robustness; test is not used for tuning or selection
